complexity.notes: Two clean binary searches is fine, but a ||single pass that checks which half is sorted and discards the other|| achieves the same O(log n) with one loop. The final return line is hard to read; an explicit `if nums[start % len(nums)] == target` would be clearer. Assumes `List` is imported.
complexity.summary: Finds the rotation point with a first binary search, then runs a second binary search over the rotated index space, mapping virtual indices back with modular arithmetic.
